title: Prospective drug utilization review
rule_summary: Before dispensing, a pharmacist must perform the prospective drug utilization review required by 247 CMR 9.17 and resolve clinically significant issues through professional judgment and communication.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply prospective review requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing prospective review with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
